body.narrative_en: Batch b-05713f68d52c was evaluated with profile VM0044@1.2 for a high-technology facility. The deterministic calculation gives a central estimate of 258487 kg CO2e, with a conservative interval from 247890 to 269292 kg CO2e. At most 247890 kg CO2e would be issuable after verification. This is a recommendation for human review, not a verification, certification or compliance statement.
